_doc: The charter goals of a new town's first days (Systems/Goals.cs): an ordered list, `shown` open at a time. A goal is met when its measure reaches its target; it pays its small reward once (gold, mandate, festival days of good cheer) and the next one shows. A goal with `gain` counts only what is added after it shows. Measures: households, tier (0 thorp, 1 hamlet, 2 village), built:<building id>, painted:<Zone> (whole tiles of that zone, built on or not), watch (watchmen, a watch house counting as one), decided (motions the mayor signed or vetoed), motions (waiting on the mayor), or any tutorial measure (count:<Town list>, zoned...). Past `lapse` days the list closes unfinished, quietly. Keep rewards small: the stand-in mayor meets these too. `point` is the button the card points at while the goal is the next one with a point (a tutorial anchor, tab:<Tab>, zone:<Zone> for that brush, place:<building>); `when` is a measure that must be above 0 before it points (motions: one is waiting); `icon` is from godot/assets/icons. Keep text to a few words.
